Playbook.name: FortiGate — Lateral Movement: Admin-Protocol Fan-Out from Non-Admin Host - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: One internal host made accepted connections on admin protocols (SMB 445, RPC 135, RDP 3389, WinRM, SSH) to many internal destinations - admin-protocol fan-out, a lateral-movement signature. Triage question: is this a compromised host spreading, or a legitimate management/admin system doing its job?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Fan-out on admin protocols is how attackers pivot across a network after initial access; catching it early limits blast radius.

Assets.AssetType: FortiGate perimeter and internal firewalls (HQ + DR)
Internal server and user segments behind the FortiGate

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: FortiGate logs shipped via Elastic Agent to logs-fortinet_fortigate.* (verified live).

Fields: fortinet.firewall.subtype (ips/dns/...), fortinet.firewall.action, fortinet.firewall.severity, fortinet.firewall.attack, fortinet.firewall.srccountry/dstcountry ('Reserved' = RFC1918 internal), fortinet.firewall.cfgpath, dns.question.name, source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port.

Signal.Name: Admin-protocol fan-out
Signal.Details: internal-to-internal accept on admin ports to many destinations.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Management servers (SCCM, monitoring, backup, PAM jump hosts) legitimately fan out on admin protocols; a user workstation or app server doing so is the lateral-movement concern.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the fan-out source is a legitimate management system or an unexpected host moving laterally.

Step.name: Fan-out breadth and protocol mix
Step.Purpose: How many destinations on which admin ports - broad SMB/RDP fan-out from one host is the signature.
Step.Query: FROM logs-fortinet_fortigate.traffic-* | WHERE source.ip == "$source_ip" AND fortinet.firewall.action == "accept" AND destination.port IN (445, 135, 3389, 5985, 5986, 22) AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS conns = COUNT(*), targets = COUNT_DISTINCT(destination.ip), target_list = VALUES(destination.ip) BY destination.port | SORT conns DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: Broad SMB(445)/RDP(3389) fan-out to many hosts = lateral movement. A management host shows a consistent, known target set; a compromised host shows new, broad targets.

Step.name: Does the source normally do this / what is it
Step.Purpose: Compare against the host's broader profile to separate a management system from an anomalous fan-out.
Step.Query: FROM logs-fortinet_fortigate.traffic-* | WHERE source.ip == "$source_ip" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS total = COUNT(*), distinct_dsts = COUNT_DISTINCT(destination.ip), admin_conns = COUNT(CASE(destination.port IN (445,135,3389,5985,5986,22), 1, null)) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: A host whose traffic is overwhelmingly admin-protocol fan-out is either a management system or actively spreading. Correlate the IP with CMDB role.

Node.Condition: INV-01 shows broad admin-protocol fan-out from a host that is NOT a documented management system.
Node.Result: True Positive (Lateral Movement - isolate source, IR)

Node.Condition: INV-01 shows fan-out combined with prior exploit/IPS activity from the same source (pivot from PB-FG-006).
Source is a documented management/PAM/backup/monitoring server with a known target set.
Fan-out from a server with an unclear role.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-FGFAN-SHAPE, INV-02-FGFAN-ROLE to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: A legitimate management system (SCCM, monitoring, backup, PAM jump host).

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the management role; baseline the host; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: A compromised host pivoting across the network on admin protocols.

Indicators.Item: Broad fan-out from a non-management host.

SOCAction.Item: Isolate the source; open IR; scope which targets it reached.
Reset credentials used from the host; hunt the spread.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A misconfigured tool performing broad admin connections unnecessarily.

Indicators.Item: A known tool over-connecting due to misconfig.

SOCAction.Item: Fix the tool scope; document and baseline.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Isolate the source if not a management host.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Reset credentials used from the host; triage targets; eradicate.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Restrict admin protocols to management hosts; enforce PAM; segment east-west.

QualityChecks.Check: Management-host allowlist is the key triage input - maintain it.

FalsePositiveClosure.Item: Management role confirmed; target set known; documented.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Source isolated; spread scoped; credentials reset; eradicated.
